title: Assistant access
lead: Your own AI assistant, for example Claude Desktop, can search your library and read items. If you permit it, it can also propose your lines for matching. It cannot change, send, or share anything: you approve or decline each proposal here.
name: Assistant
lab_closed: Your lab does not permit assistants.
consent: {name} and the company that runs it can read the text that it gets from these places.
setup_help: Copy this text into the MCP settings of {name}. Then start {name} again.
lab_closed_cloud: Your lab permits assistants that run on this computer only.
class_cloud: On the servers of a company
class_cloud_help: For example Claude Desktop, ChatGPT, or Cursor. The company can read what the assistant reads.
class_local_help: For example a local model. Choose this only if you are sure.
consent_local: {name} can read the text that it gets from these places. You say that it runs on this computer only.
acts: It can propose my lines for matching (I approve each proposal)
expires_help: Optional. On this day the access stops.
http_help: An assistant that cannot start a program can connect on this computer by a local web address with a key.
http_make: Make a key for a local web address
http_new: Make a new key (the old key stops)
http_once: Copy the key now. Anagram shows it one time.
http_command: Command that starts the local web address
pending_help: Read each proposal. Nothing changes until you approve it.
proposal_flag: This text has words that look like orders to a model. Read it carefully before you approve it.
